summary: The change removes the page-load status write from setPasswordLabelForMode and moves the passkey-unavailable guidance into the invalid_credentials path, which the server also uses for accounts without passwords. The password-management and passkey-capable paths are excluded from that fallback, and no test asserts the removed copy.

evidence: public/auth.js:420-422 no longer writes a status message when selecting password mode, and the sign-in initialization at public/auth.js:743-748 clears #status, leaving the live region and form description empty on load when passkey support is unavailable.

public/auth.js:357-365 appends the passkey-unavailable guidance only for invalid_credentials on non-management, non-backup sign-in when usePasskey is false; src/passport.ts:713-733 returns that error for both wrong passwords and accounts without a password.

public/auth.js:701-727 preserves the bootstrap.managePassword password/backup-password setup and status handling, while public/auth.js:38 retains the task's existing guidance copy for the applicable fallback path.
No test asserts the removed copy; the new passkey-unavailable string occurs only in public/auth.js.
